name: Document Loader: Field Widget Actions
description: Adds Field Widget Actions button that extracts document contents into a destination field via Document Loader.
project_description: Document Loader: Field Widget Actions adds a "Load Document" button to field widgets. Attached to a source widget (file, image, media, link, or text), the button extracts the source document's content through the Document Loader pipeline and fills a configurable destination field (text_long, text_with_summary, or a JSON field type) on the same form display via AJAX. It requires the Field Widget Actions module and stores per-loader options using Document Loader's dl__{loader_id}__{option_key} namespacing. JSON destination fields automatically force JSON output.
